planItems.scope: Claude response adapter and streaming bridge for Antigravity and Agy mint a 128-bit local message correlation ID only when both reviewed upstream ID spellings are absent, non-string or blank. Valid upstream bytes survive unchanged; an emitted stream identity never changes. Each synthetic grounding use/result pair shares one newly minted local ID.

Unidentified args-only calls fail with a latched protocol error. Only a known un-emitted explicit ID may inherit an already fixed tool name. Unknown or conflicting names never become a default executable tool; no most-recent-tool heuristic is enabled without independent same-rail evidence.

bounds.idGenerator: existing rand 0.8 + hex 0.4; 16 random bytes; no new dependency
bounds.messageLifetime: one ID for one response; retained String charged by existing stream owner
bounds.failureLifetime: transform and finish reject after identity failure; no buffered tool flush or success repair
bounds.terminal: non-null functionCall after a pending finish marker fails; optional functionCall:null does not turn legitimate text into tool use
bounds.scope: only local Claude bridge identities; no upstream resource, persistence, remote continuation, account authority or signed-history grant

redEvidence.result: missing response IDs reused gemini across responses; unidentified args became an extra executable tool named tool
redEvidence.excluded: red1 missing trait import was a fixture compilation error, not product evidence

validation.rustInputDigestMethod: sha256 of sorted canonical path/sha256 array; json sort_keys true and compact separators; src/tests Rust plus Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/build.rs
validation.scopeNote: Observed source at class validation; unrelated concurrent API/state edits after original freeze are listed, so exact full-worktree rebuild attestation is deferred to final integration. Provider sources unchanged.

limitations: Local adapters/codecs are not real vendor acceptance or Router ingress verification.
No independent wire evidence authorizes guessing a nameless continuation by slot or most recent tool.
One direct-binary agy attempt omitted the required large test-thread stack and aborted; the final run sets RUST_MIN_STACK=67108864 and passes.
No UI automation, deployment, real-account changes, commit or push. Both real rails remain live_pending.
